verdict.summary: Issue #217 is not implementation-ready. Its execution contract is substantially bounded, but canonical ownership, platform and release-security policy, launcher migration, default-tier behavior, freshness, and archive policy still require authenticated owner decisions, while the blocking dependency revisions and checks remain unverified.

blockingFindings.title: Required owner decisions O217-1 through O217-7 remain unresolved
blockingFindings.details: The specification cannot establish a single executable owner lane or objective final acceptance until authenticated, issue-specific owner answers define the canonical manager repository/path and authorized children, supported-platform matrix, default logical-tier request behavior, complete deterministic signing and key-lifecycle policy, stale launcher binding and migration target, manifest-freshness policy, and archive admission contract. The supplied owner comment is truncated and does not completely authorize any decision. Obtain complete answers for every applicable decision and review the resulting exact issue version again.

blockingFindings.title: Blocking dependency chain lacks trusted exact-revision evidence
blockingFindings.details: The contract depends on #253, #260, and #275, but the trusted verified state establishes only issue #217's current version and the repository default branch. It does not prove the exact merged default-branch revision, required green checks, ancestry, or consumed-revision binding for each dependency. Provide trusted exact-revision evidence and bind #217 validation to those revisions before admitting CLI/TUI implementation or release integration.

nonBlockingNotes: The issue correctly carries P1 and df:ask-owner and does not carry df:reviewed.
Owner escalation remains required for O217-1 through O217-7; each authenticated answer authorizes only its named decision.
After the owner decisions and dependency evidence are recorded, the exact resulting issue version requires a complete new iterative review.
